scope.selection: Every unchecked checklist item before each phase exit, verbatim; 14 P2 and 5 P7. Checked items are context, not reassessed.
scope.method: Offline selective inspection of current source, tests and retained receipts; no test execution, network, model or job restart. Missing means no project-level implementation evidenced in inspected scope; not a proof of global absence.
scope.limitations: Retained test reports are historical assertions, not tests rerun here. No current provider price or scheduler state was queried. Pilot evidence and library primitives are not full completion.

items.requirement: Build a closed jurisdiction/official-source registry with aliases and election-portal hosts.
items.limits: Existing inventory and ballot identifiers are inputs; no reviewed closed cross-jurisdiction registry with aliases, verified official/election and vendor hosts was established.
items.concrete_next_action: Build and review a versioned closed registry with source-backed hosts, unresolved entries and aliases; contract-test IDs.

items.requirement: Build sparse bc-spec worklists for inventory refresh, election census and gap discovery.
items.limits: Separate deterministic inventory and ballot lists and prepared discovery jobs exist; no integrated bc-spec sparse three-lane plan with recorded dimensions and exclusions was demonstrated.
items.concrete_next_action: Map registry and inventory IDs into bc-spec cells for all three lanes; preserve priorities, exclusions and unresolved dimensions.

items.requirement: Add deterministic plan preview, seeded sampling and call/cost estimates.
items.limits: Prepared jobs and per-job caps are not a reproducible stratified seeded search plan with full call and USD estimates.
items.concrete_next_action: Add deterministic versioned preview, seed, sampling frame, per-stage counts and known/unknown price estimates.

items.requirement: Configure provider-specific Exa/Google query variants through `Searcher.search_many`.
items.limits: Client invokes search once per explicit backend with native domain filters; no project adapter using named provider-specific search_many variants was located.
items.concrete_next_action: Render named Exa semantic and Google exact/domain variants per intent, preserving pre-call reservations and domain diagnostics.

items.requirement: Retain rank fusion provenance, original sightings, response hashes and backend errors.

evidence_paths.support: verified cohort totals and ledger fingerprints

items.limits: Cohort verifies response hashes, sightings, errors and unpriced calls; Jay canonical cohort is bounded. Normalizer explicitly excludes rank fusion; legacy exceptions and missing historical intent persist.
items.concrete_next_action: Integrate fusion with per-variant ranks and original response/error links, migrate reviewed cohorts and reconcile exceptions without manufacturing missing intent.

items.requirement: Add Google News RSS/GDELT and bounded paid-news escalation with index-window decline handling.

evidence_paths.support: GoogleNewsSearch, GdeltSearch and declined index window
verified cohort totals and ledger fingerprints

items.limits: Individual Google News and GDELT searches and decline distinctions exist; no demonstrated coordinated news clustering, measured paid escalation and fallback policy.
items.concrete_next_action: Add capped free-to-paid escalation, preserve publisher/cluster provenance and route GDELT declines to documented older-source recovery.

items.requirement: Add intent-specific query expansion, primary-host discovery, historical time walks and undated-source recovery.
items.limits: Publication windows and individual domain searches exist; no integrated intent expansion, verified host discovery, time walks and undated recovery across search cells demonstrated.
items.concrete_next_action: Connect native intent, discovery and walk facilities with registry-verified hosts and explicit unfiltered recovery; record each stage and scope.

items.requirement: Add exact-identifier/reference chasing, feedback queries and bounded relaxation.

evidence_paths.support: Due work; Acquisition and interruption; Restore and release preparation; search cohort

items.limits: Individual retained recovery cases exist, but no general bounded feedback/chase/relaxation orchestration or complete reason and provenance trail demonstrated.
items.concrete_next_action: Integrate exact identifier chasing and bounded feedback/relaxation with original question, reasons, limits and unresolved chase gaps.

items.requirement: Calibrate ResearchSearch tiers without excluding primary sources or reverse-polarity measures.
items.limits: Library tiers exist; no project calibration measuring primary-source or reverse-polarity exclusion against a frozen holdout was established.
items.concrete_next_action: Freeze representative pilot/holdout and measure tier recall and false exclusions, including authoritative URL bypass and reverse polarity.

items.requirement: Reserve bounded deep_research/source-agent use for difficult cases; retain skipped stages and conversations.
items.limits: Native capabilities are not evidence of a configured project difficult-case policy, budgets, or retained skipped stages and conversations.
items.concrete_next_action: Define escalation criteria and hard budgets, retain complete stage/chase and conversation records, then validate offline with fixtures before any authorized pilot.

items.requirement: Configure current SerpAPI pricing and whole-run/per-stage budgets, including unpriced-call policy.
items.limits: Persistent search/fetch call caps and separate unknown prices exist; no verified current SerpAPI rate or shared USD/token meter across all stages. No current price was sought under offline constraint.
items.concrete_next_action: Establish approved pricing and conservative unpriced reservation policy; enforce a shared whole-run meter and per-stage call/token/USD ceilings.

items.requirement: Pin model roles/settings and cache fingerprints; redact secrets from retained responses.
items.limits: Some CLI model settings and client/config hashes are retained, and search response sink replaces configured provider key bytes. This does not establish all model roles/settings, content/schema/prompt/model/settings fingerprints, or comprehensive redaction including authenticated URLs.
items.concrete_next_action: Pin every role and dependency revision/settings; fingerprint document/schema/prompt/model/settings and validate redaction for URLs, headers, responses and failures.

items.requirement: Configure source/provider pacing, Retry-After, explicit retries and verified routing as applicable.
items.limits: Client explicitly disables provider retries and retains failure reservations; library rate primitives do not establish project-wide source/public-IP pacing, Retry-After handling, controlled retries or verified routing.
items.concrete_next_action: Configure and test per-origin/provider quotas, Retry-After and bounded separately accounted retries; verify egress only if applicable.

items.requirement: Make partial backend failure and zero-result cells distinguishable in coverage reports.

evidence_paths.support: verified cohort totals and ledger fingerprints

items.limits: Normalizer and cohort distinguish outcomes by attempt, but a bounded audited ledger cohort is not complete per-cell coverage with partial backend failures, explicit zero results and unresolved gaps across planned scope.
items.concrete_next_action: Join all planned cells and attempts, report attempted/declined/failed/zero/unattempted per backend and query family, and retain scope failures.

items.requirement: Implement due-work rules for qualification, elections, certification/recounts, implementation and expiry.

evidence_paths.support: scheduled, successor, advisory and partial date tests

items.limits: Ballot and inventory prompts cover portions of qualification, election, certification, implementation and expiry. Exact-date-only rules, no statutory deadlines, no comprehensive recount/amendment/event triggers, and no task resolution or inventory-wide calibration.
items.concrete_next_action: Extend source-aware lifecycle triggers and explicit task resolution across records, including recounts, implementation and supported expiry; calibrate against reviewed cases.

items.requirement: Exercise an end-to-end correction and refresh cycle manually.

evidence_paths.support: Due work; Acquisition and interruption; Restore and release preparation; search cohort
identity replay and interrupted transaction validation

items.limits: Individual correction, replay, cache and planner exercises exist; no evidenced single manual cycle from due detection through reacquisition, review, correction, export and regenerated freshness/backlog on released contracts.
items.concrete_next_action: Exercise one authorized bounded correction and subsequent refresh end-to-end, preserving before/after hashes and each stage receipt; do not restart old jobs.

items.requirement: Track source failures, backend contribution, coverage gaps, freshness and review backlog.

evidence_paths.support: verified cohort totals and ledger fingerprints
Due work; Acquisition and interruption; Restore and release preparation; search cohort

items.limits: Cohort failures and backend totals, due-work and field accounting exist in separate scoped reports; no unified complete search-cell contribution, source freshness and review backlog tracking.
items.concrete_next_action: Join planned cells, attempt outcomes, unique backend contribution, source-specific observation times, and review dispositions with explicit missingness.

items.requirement: Document operator recovery, storage restore, interruption and budget-stop procedures.

evidence_paths.support: Due work; Acquisition and interruption; Restore and release preparation; search cohort

items.limits: Instructions cover preserving ledgers and observing process handles, metadata backup, and bundle restore; they explicitly do not demonstrate independent full blob restore or a comprehensive budget-stop/resume runbook.
items.concrete_next_action: Write and validate a restore/reconciliation and interruption/budget-stop procedure covering metadata plus blobs, integrity, safe resume, unpriced spend and explicit checkpoints.

items.requirement: Create schedules only if explicitly requested; record cutoff, scope and budget for each.

evidence_paths.support: Due work; Acquisition and interruption; Restore and release preparation; search cohort

items.limits: Documented policy says no schedule installed and requires separate request. No independent scheduler inventory or per-schedule cutoff/scope/budget receipt was inspected; no schedule was created by this review.
items.concrete_next_action: Maintain no-implicit-scheduling policy; if explicitly requested, record authorization, cutoff, scope, budgets and disable/recovery details for each schedule.

Connect named provider variants, native fusion and provenance to planned cells; reuse bc-web Searcher and bc-research search pool; preserve failures and existing ledgers.

Freeze holdout and calibrate search tiers and difficult-case escalation, with primary and reverse-polarity recall.
Unify source freshness, coverage, backend contribution and review backlog; expand due rules and explicit task resolution.
